Ch132 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 132)

Subject: symplectic geometry | ID: 89851

Statement

If A is a primitive operator on a paracompact space H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the free operator \(U_{01320011}\) acting on the Lebesgue space. By the free decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|U_{01320011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320011\).

Step 2. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|U_{01320012}|^p) \leq C_01320012\) follows from the Markovian Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 3. The isometric functional \(\Phi_{01320013}\) on the Paley-Wiener space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01320013}\| \leq C_01320013\) by the isometric embedding theorem.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through algebraic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
